receptor: PPARalpha ligand-binding domain, PDB 1K7L chain A (co-crystallised with the agonist GW409544)
sanity: PFOA (C8, known agonist) -7.7 kcal/mol ranks above PFBS (C4) -6.5, i.e. long chain > short chain, consistent with the trend reported by Evans et al. 2022
limitations: smina with Vina scoring; GNINA CNN rescoring or MM-GBSA would be a refinement
6:2 FTOH is a precursor, so its PPARalpha activity appears only after metabolism
the docking spread is narrow (-6.5 to -7.8 kcal/mol); placing small anions in a large lipophilic pocket limits discriminating power
